entities.summary: Naitō Torajirō , commonly known as Naitō Konan , was a Japanese historian and Sinologist. He was the founder of the Kyoto School of historiography, and along with Shiratori Kurakichi, was one of the leading Japanese historians of East Asia in the early twentieth century. His most well-known book is called Nara.
